title: bayescompR: Pure R Implementation of the Stan Modeling Language
description: A pure R implementation of the Stan modeling language (version 2.40) and of many inference algorithms. Stan programs are parsed, type checked and compiled into R closures on a reverse mode automatic differentiation tape, and fitted with the No-U-Turn sampler and the other CmdStan methods (optimization, Laplace approximation, ADVI, Pathfinder, generated quantities), with CmdStan's adaptation, output files and diagnostics, as well as many further samplers and approximations. No C++ compiler, CmdStan or rstan is required. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Stan Development Team or NumFOCUS.
